name: Demo — 2015 Ukraine Electric Power Attack
description: Demo scenario inspired by the publicly documented 2015 Ukraine electric power attack. Enterprise behaviors and contextual reconnaissance are enriched for matrix visualization; this is not an authoritative incident reconstruction or an ICS ATT&CK layer.

layers.name: Target Reconnaissance
layers.description: Research victim domains, personnel, software, and business relationships to prepare targeted access against critical infrastructure operators.

layers.name: Corporate Perimeter
layers.description: Deliver malicious Office attachments and rely on user interaction to establish the initial enterprise foothold.

layers.name: Enterprise Network
layers.description: Execute BlackEnergy-related components, discover reachable systems, capture credentials from network traffic, and move toward operational access paths.

layers.name: Critical Operations Boundary
layers.description: Represent enterprise-visible preparation and disruptive effects around critical operations while retaining Enterprise ATT&CK identifiers only.
